tools.name: ads_get_ad_entities
tools.description: Read campaigns, ad sets or ads with their status, settings and, for ads, their post (effective_object_story_id).

tools.name: ads_create_adset
tools.description: Create an ad set. Arguments: ad_account_id, campaign_id, name, daily_budget or lifetime_budget (not when the campaign holds the budget), optimization_goal, billing_event, bid_strategy, promoted_object, targeting, status (ACTIVE or PAUSED).

tools.name: ads_create_ad
tools.description: Create an ad in an ad set, from a creative or from an existing post (object_story_id). Arguments: ad_account_id, adset_id, creative_id or object_story_id, name, status (ACTIVE or PAUSED).

tools.name: ads_get_ad_preview
tools.description: A preview link of an ad.

tools.name: ads_update_entity
tools.description: Change a campaign, ad set or ad: its status (ACTIVE or PAUSED), budget or name.

tools.name: ads_activate_entity
tools.description: Switch a campaign, ad set or ad on (ACTIVE): it starts delivering and spending.
